title: Refactor Semio Net and Gh Type Safety
description: Refactor semio net and semio gh dynamic/non-type-safe code to explicit compile-time-safe paths and resolve ApplyDiff overload mismatch compile error.
summary: Refactored semio gh dynamic ApplyDiff and persistence flows to strongly typed compile-time-safe contracts; removed dynamic dispatch and anonymous runtime payloads; restored missing headless import helper and fixed fallback return kind mismatch. Verified net build passes and gh net8 target builds.
